MileQuill Lite Terms of Service

Version 1.0  |  November 25, 2026

By using the software provided, you agree to the terms of this agreement. If you do not agree with the terms discontinue use immediately

This agreement is between Naiomi Summers, the publisher, and you. The publisher grants you a nonexclusive right to use MileQuill Lite to keep mileage, shift, pay and expense records for yourself or for work you are authorized to document.

Trips and working time

You enter miles or odometer readings, dates, shifts, earnings and expenses. Review the business purpose, origins or destinations where needed, and your time and supporting documents. The app does not independently verify a journey or provide automatic GPS evidence. Enter or review records only when safely parked or otherwise safely away from driving.

Earnings and mileage reports

Estimated net subtracts the expenses you logged from gross pay. Net per hour depends on the time you entered. These figures do not calculate a tax deduction, minimum wage compliance, an employer’s reimbursement or take-home pay after tax. You are responsible for the mileage and classifications you submit. Keep the underlying log and any supporting records required by your employer or tax authority. The publisher does not provide tax or employment advice.

Device storage and exports

The app stores records in this browser without vault encryption or automatic cloud sync. People with access to the browser profile may be able to read them. A Home Screen installation may use a different store. Keep a private full JSON backup before clearing site data, switching devices or restoring. A restore replaces the local lists. The trip, shift and expense CSVs are readable and export all records of their type, including dates outside the displayed reporting period.

Use of records and software

You keep whatever rights you have in your records and exports. Enter, import and share only material you are authorized to handle. Use the software lawfully. Do not falsify records, use another person’s credentials without permission, or interfere with others’ access. Do not send private records to a public project channel.

Naiomi Summers and the applicable rights holders retain their respective rights in the software, names and artwork. Any separate license accompanying a component governs that component and preserves the rights it grants. This agreement gives no permission to imply endorsement.

The publisher may suspend or discontinue its distribution, downloads or hosted access at any time, subject to applicable law.

Ending use

You may stop using the software and retain your records and exports. Ending public distribution does not revoke permission to use a lawfully obtained copy in compliance with these terms.
